Sandeep vs New India Insurance Company Limited on 6 April,
2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:8835
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Indore

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi

On The 6 th Of April, 2026
 Misc. Appeal No. 892 of 2015
 Sandeep
 Versus
 New India Insurance Company Limited And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Kamal Kishore Kaushal - Advocate for the appella
 Shri Pradip Kumar Gupta - Advocate for respondent no.
 Order
This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the
appellant assailing the impugned award dated 22.01.2015 passed by Xv Additional Member Motor
Accident Claim

s Tribunal, Indore (M.P.) in Claim Case No.258/2013, whereby an amount of Rs.75,303/- along with interest has been awarded in favour of the appellant/claimant fixing 50% of contributory negligence on the injured.

2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the injured was travelling in the motorcycle and collision was with a Truck bearing registration no.RJ-14-GC-3309 which was driven rashly and negligently.
No counter FIR has been lodged against the claimant.
By mere statement of the claimant that he collided with the truck cannot be assumed that he was contributed in the accident.

On the aforesaid contention learned counsel for the appellant prays for allowing the appeal by setting aside the finding given NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8835 2 MA-892-2015 with regard to the contributory negligence which has been given in para 10 of the impugned award.

3 . Per contra, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has opposed the prayer on the ground that the evidence available on record clearly reveals the contributory negligence is on the part of the claimant/appellant.
Hence, the finding given by the learned Claims Tribunal cannot be interfered with.
4. Heard and considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text:
5. It is not in dispute that the accident took place on 05.06.2012 in the day time afternoon at 2 P.M.
on the Mhow Neemuch road wherein Truck bearing registration no.RJ-14-GC-3309 collided with the motorcycle of the claimant.
From the perusal of the evidence available on record it cannot be assumed that claimant contributed any percentage in the accident.

Therefore, this Court is of the view that mere statement of the claimant that the accident took place due to collision with the truck cannot be assumed that he has contributed negligence to the extent of 50% in the accident which has been taken by the Claims Tribunal.
The aforesaid finding cannot be sustained.
Hence, this Court is of the view that the aforesaid finding of contributory negligence is hereby set aside which will result in total award amount of Rs.1,50,606/- along with interest.

6. Accordingly, this Misc. Appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation by Rs.75,303/-
over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The appeal has been valued at Rs.1 lakh, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8835 3 MA-892-2015 hence no further Court fee is required to be paid.
The amount will also carry interest at the same rate as awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award including rate of interest shall remain intact.
(BINOD KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE RJ Sandeep vs New India Insurance Company Limited on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99065843/
